Source code availability (GPL-3.0-or-later)
===========================================

punjdrone is free software under the GNU General Public License v3 (see COPYING).
If you distribute these binaries, you must also make the corresponding source
available to the recipients.

Project repository:
  https://github.com/subeep/onlydrone.git

This Windows build corresponds to commit:
  5ad8e1f3834bccaa67843fd670a5b15477273f94
plus local working-tree changes (Windows port, UHD C-API adapter, and the O4
candidate detector) that were not yet committed at build time. The complete
corresponding source — including those local changes and the pinned GLFW 3.4 and
FFTW 3.3.10 dependency archives used for the static build — is kept in the build
workspace and must accompany the binaries if you redistribute them.

Third-party components and their licenses are listed in THIRD_PARTY.md.
No UHD runtime DLL is included or redistributed here; install UHD separately.
